stops.note: past participle of 'perficere', to complete, from 'per-', thoroughly, plus 'facere', to make
'parfait glacé' named a rich frozen dessert of cream, eggs and sugar in French cookery
in American usage it became a layered dessert of ice cream or yogurt with fruit in a tall glass

current_meaning: a dessert of layered ice cream or cream, fruit and other ingredients, served in a tall glass
